questions.question: In Ezekiel's prophecy, what did God say Gog of Magog would devise in his mind on the day he came against Israel?
In Ezekiel's prophecy, God said He would pour rain, hailstones, fire and sulfur on Gog of Magog and on which others?

answers.text: His troops and the nations with him

questions.question: In Ezekiel's prophecy, why did God say He would bring Gog against His land?

answers.text: So the nations may know Him
So Gog's own people are punished
So Israel's army can be tested

questions.question: In Ezekiel's prophecy, when God summoned a sword against Gog on His mountains, every man's sword would be against whom?
